trained_on: the REAL crawled corpus (data/index.bin + crawler.db, 19,514 docs) and scripts/evaluate_real.py's hand-verified judgment set -- 20 queries, real documents, real relevance judgments (not programmatically derived from corpus-generation metadata)
method: sklearn.linear_model.Ridge(positive=True, alpha=1.0), balanced sample weights, coefficients renormalized to sum to 1.
deployment_recommendation: NOT recommended -- judgment set exhibits confirmed selection bias toward high-authority domains (relevant docs' mean PageRank is 58x the corpus mean), which directly inflates PageRank's apparent importance independent of whether it actually predicts relevance. Needs a bias-corrected judgment set before this weight is trustworthy.
